svg.title: gle-BAOAB, one step
svg.desc: One step of the quasi-Markovian generalised Langevin equation: a force half-step, a drift half-step, an exact Ornstein-Uhlenbeck step for the auxiliary variables at frozen configuration, then the drift and force half-steps again. Scheme (B.1) of Sachs' thesis, with the mass matrix restored.
